notes.title: Fallen Knight: Rebellion & Rise Of The Fallen DLC Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/2391f89fa5fb816f8ccca78193e6b5d2962fc7cc.png[/img]

Lancelot returns in our third DLC! 

Take on the role of Lancelot, the Knight of Round, after being rescued by his friend Galahad. Imprisoned for five years, Lancelot is tasked with a mission to defeat the world's greatest threat - Cathedral. Take back the Holy Power from hostile enemies, save humanity, and get revenge for your friend. The 'true ending' of the Fallen Knight series will end in this chapter.

OUT NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934060/Fallen_Knight_Rebellion__Rise_Of_The_Fallen/

notes.title: Fallen Knight: Rebellion of the Fallen Is Available Now!
notes.content:
Happy Monday, Knights of the Round Table!

We’ve got a little surprise coming your way: The Fallen Knight DLC [i]“Fallen Knight: Rebellion of the Fallen” [/i]is available now!

Since the destruction of the Holy Grail, the cathedral has been desperate to find a new Heart of the Holy Grail – but becoming the Heart comes with a price. Rescue Oracle who has been selected for the role from a horrible fate and fight everyone in your way, including your fellow Knights of the Round! 

The new DLC comes with a new story ‘Holy Duel’ featuring [b]4 to 7 hours of game time and plenty of new mechanics, skills, and abilities![/b]

Check out the launch trailer below!

[previewyoutube=WPlFcbx59d4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Have you got what it takes to rescue Oracle? Play the DLC to find out![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934060/Fallen_Knight_Rebellion_of_the_Fallen/

notes.title: Fallen Knight Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Hope everyone is staying healthy and well! After speaking with the community and receiving feedback we have made some adjustments to Lancelot's heal! For more details do read below.

[h2]Fallen Knight Patch 1.05 Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lancelot is now allowed to heal himself whilst moving and holding the heal button (applies after ≈2.5 secs). This applies to all movement; running, dashing, jumping, wall running, etc. 
[*] Idle/sitting healing speed has been reduced from 2 secs to 1.5 secs (Focus Heal has been adjusted as well).
[*] Reduced "Double Heal" unlock criteria from 500HP to 50HP.
[*] Fixed and improved Japanese localization.
[*] Fixed bug where previously players are unable to press any button at the "Results" screen after defeating Lucifer.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing, Nikolai The Rogue Knight!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/0ef9a7ec00dcb74bebdd7eb0780e497d944de99d.png[/img]

During [b]Next Fest[/b], players were able to download our demo for a limited time. Those who has the chance to play Fallen Knight were confronted with [b]the Rogue Knight, Nikolai![/b] A challenging quest even before reaching his lair, you must be fast inside the mines, [b]the ceilings can be very unstable...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/3282298d8d138d9c55a4cfab90e55e458e9f4d09.gif[/img]

[h1]Night Of Knights[/h1]

[b]Deep within the Orichalcum Mines [/b]resides the traitor Knight, Nikolai. Surrounded by scorching magma, you must defeat this treacherous foe! Nikolai turned his back against the Cathedral, he could not watch while the other Knights enslaved people. Abandoning the Knights Code one bloody night, he never looked back, [b]and did what he believes needed to be done...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/67c0c7ccdf926df98179e61de554e8c9e051bee5.gif[/img]

[h1]Too Hot Too Handle[/h1]

Keep your wits about you with this boss, he wields a powerful mace with a force strong enough to disturb the flow of lava to whichever direction he chooses, [b]so a well timed dodge won't go amiss![/b] With impeccable concentration you'll no doubt have Nikolai kneeling on this battlefield, but it won't be easy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/dc7b86c9f9a969fc65bbe59bcba766dfb14ed1b7.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and insights into the lore and mechanics of Fallen Knight!

notes.title: Gameplay Mechanics, Combat!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/f2bc54cbb77043a5b469acd49b9806aa1c45306e.png[/img]


[h2]Basic Attacks[/h2]

Lancelot's missions often start by fighting his way through[b] masses of enemies[/b] to reach his goal. [b]Using his basic attack combo can have a devastating effect[/b]. Normal attack is a [b]powerful and fast strike[/b], followed by a jump attack and slash is[b] a sure way to win each encounter![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/ebd3f641016d5c374cc9db40968282fb213b2f94.gif[/img]


[h2]Counter, Parry & Disarm[/h2]

A battle technique only the strongest of knights can [i]master! [/i]Wait for the enemy to attack first, and with a well timed strike, disarm or parry[i] neutralising  your opponent. Slice rockets out of the air, or deflect bullets at insane speeds!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/3fb0aa725a47e953ce8173fd6bd27c6387c8a4f3.gif[/img]


[h2]Wrath Of God[/h2]

A technique from the Gods themselves,[b] a catastrophic attack which allows you to defeat multiple enemies at once.[/b] Once your Wrath of God meter is fully charged, [i]let loose your fury![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/512ddc51ea7d7df8e8b0d2760c650c275b55b68f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Strike, The Black Lightning!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/eadacf87b562fe650a45e71c8d856e606c29e6f5.gif[/img]


[h2]Prepare Yourself![/h2]

[b]Lightning fast and a specialist in close quarters combat[/b], Strike puts an end to his opponents before they even notice. Rumoured to be a former champion, [b]and now notorious as a merciless demon[/b], he is an elite member of enemy forces, The Purge.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/d0021b269d003792f1c83b81e942cd81b993fd51.gif[/img]


[h2]The Art Of Parrying[/h2]

[b]Collect your honour points [/b]for this battle, dodging Strike's attacks won't be an easy feat. You must match his speed with a well placed parry, [b]giving you a small window to attack![/b] Fight atop a run-away train headed for disaster in this rapid brawl of legends!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/72fbbf96cd8e53f3f70a1028b9191a48511a532a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Emo Walker Pierrot!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/acfdf23b8dda14cdf18d3f715993a83f5efc61bd.gif[/img]


[h2]Trick Or Treat![/h2]

Known underground as[i] the Code Breaker[/i], [b]Pierrot is a dark and sinister mystery clad in neon lights.[/b] A trickster by nature, he will manipulate your very surroundings to secure his win. You must be vigilant in defeating this foe and have faith in your abilities! Parry his lightening-fast attacks,[b] jump, dash and dodge,[/b] or succumb to his flashing deadly darts.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/5cbd9e9b3aa841565ac706116b82eae3ce82b78d.gif[/img]


[h2]The Code Breaker[/h2]

Little is known about his past, but Pierrot is severely disabled, [b]a result of surviving bouts of heinous torture at the hands of his foes[/b]. He now wears a suit fashioned from the Knights' very own [i]Holy Technology,[/i] [b]and carries an evil force within him thirsty for revenge.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/22789d5efaaca4afe78973cd9e91068429b23e6e.gif[/img]


[h2]Kill Or Disarm?[/h2]

Choose to[b] kill or skilfully parry and disarm[/b] enemies. Exhibiting the mercy and honour expected of the Round Table is more difficult, [b]but will earn you valuable 'honour points', and even unlock multiple alternate endings![/b]

notes.title: Futuristic Side-Scroller Fallen Knight Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/f2bc54cbb77043a5b469acd49b9806aa1c45306e.png[/img]

In this fast-paced futuristic[i] knights tale[/i], play as the descendant of the fabled Sir Lancelot in an armoured throw-down of the ages to [b]shield your city from The Purge.[/b]

[b]Lancelot the 50th[/b] has sworn an oath to protect the 'truth' from an evil organisation and must face off against [i]six[/i] unique enemy heroes with a [b]dark past[/b] of their own.

[h2]Introducing 'The Juggernaught' - The Lord Of Blast[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/d254d2b76d98e336f022fba9318adcca55550747.gif[/img]

A tough opponent - you must use everything you've learned to [b]conquer this enemy.[/b] 
[b]Dash, jump & slash[/b] your way to success with lightening-fast reflexes. Landing a well timed dodge is key to defeating this challenger, use your agility to contrast his [b]brute strength.[/b]

Earn honour points to [b]upgrade your abilities, health and attacks[/b]. This can be a crucial tactic to obtain your success [b]and become unstoppable![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/a6e500e0edfb4549772a92904f1d27a49a65880a.gif[/img]

All is not what it seems with your opponents, learn about their past and motives as you cut your way through your quest and [b]uncover the reality of The Purge.[/b]

Each boss is a [b]unique battle[/b], master your techniques and achieve the honour & glory worthy of a knight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/45897cdb73ae16411d42bf8653529fb6ede15c1c.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and insights into the lore and mechanics of Fallen Knight!

notes.title: See the Fallen Knight announcement trailer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/c0cbf575d010bc53bc0008c284de2c0f6a72c7a8.png[/img]

[h3]Hey Steam friends,[/h3]

Did you get a chance to see our announcement trailer? We're extremely excited to show you some Fallen Knight action ahead of our 2021 release! Keep an eye out for future Steam updates too, as we continue to break down some of the mechanics and story elements which make Fallen Knight so unique! 

[previewyoutube=qkcIyzgKdXo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What is Fallen Knight?[/b]
Fallen Knight is a futuristic knight’s tale that lets players play as a descendant of the great Lancelot in King Arthur’s tale. Take the role of this elite knight and battle your way through action-packed levels with intense sword fighting gameplay in this neo-classic side scrolling action platformer. Save the city from a deadly terrorist organisation hell-bent on exposing the truth you were sworn to protect.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/4819542e07f1d4caf6495ecbf0cc62c153268555.png[/img]
